headline: CLE @ CHW matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is CLE 4.82 at CHW 3.89, with a projected total of 8.70. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward CLE: CLE moved +0.39 runs while CHW moved -0.09, changing the projected margin by +0.48 runs. The projected total climbed +0.30, which points to more offensive expectation than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability rose +6.1%, so the first-inning read became more pitcher-friendly early. Pitching context: Anthony Kay has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 2.8 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Sam Antonacci, Travis Bazzana, Chase Meidroth, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Kahlil Watson, Jacob Gonzalez because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
